name: tab-bookmark-shortcuts
description: Tab bookmark shortcuts WebExtension - save/switch tabs across windows with 10 slots

scripts.build:chrome: cross-env TARGET_BROWSER=chrome vite build && node scripts/merge-manifest.mjs chrome && node scripts/package.mjs chrome
scripts.build:edge: cross-env TARGET_BROWSER=edge vite build && node scripts/merge-manifest.mjs edge && node scripts/package.mjs edge
scripts.build:firefox: cross-env TARGET_BROWSER=firefox vite build && node scripts/merge-manifest.mjs firefox && node scripts/package.mjs firefox
